source.archive_source: joinquant_archive/sources/2025年度精选策略/53.基于大盘PE标准差偏离度的聪明基金定投策略.py

frozen_parameters.rebalance_weekday: penultimate trading day of each week

data_contract.etf_prices: local B-grade etf_daily raw and adjusted OHLCV for SH510300
data_contract.valuation_proxy: Legulegu CSI300 aggregate static PE (addLyrPe) via AkShare stock_index_pe_lg; the calibration-only snapshot must be truncated at 2019-12-26, cached and hashed before any post-publication run
data_contract.valuation_proxy_status: cross-provider and cross-universe proxy pending public-window calibration against JoinQuant finance.STK_EXCHANGE_TRADE_INFO exchange_code 322002; Legulegu Shanghai-market PE is monthly and cannot satisfy the frozen 2500-daily-observation rule

calibration.pass_rule: all four tolerances must pass; otherwise downgrade to C and do not calculate post-publication performance

post_publication_evaluation.cash_flow_return_method: daily time-weighted return after removing external flows

first_read_advancement_gates.relative_value_rule: versus fixed-50-week DCA, Sharpe improves by at least 0.10 or drawdown improves by at least 5 percentage points without CAGR lagging by more than 2 percentage points

hard_stops: complex valuation rule has no material value over both simple cash-flow baselines
valuation proxy cannot be reproduced or productionized

deep_research_only_after_first_read.parameter_neighborhood: valuation window 2250/2500/2750; normal weeks 40/50/60; threshold multipliers varied one dimension at a time around the frozen point
multiple_testing: PBO or equivalent fold-based selection diagnostic
